title: city_join_room input
$comment: Not expressible in JSON Schema: names are trimmed before length checks and contain no control characters.

link.description: The room link (https://.../r/<slug>#<token>) or a join link (https://.../j/<code>, including a short code like https://.../j/7K4M-Q9XP).

token.description: The invite token (crr_..., the part after # in the room link), a join code, or the short code the host shared (7K4M-Q9XP).

room_id.description: Optional: the room the token must belong to. Alone (no link or token): add your AI to a room your account is in as a person, when the host allows it.

create.description: Create a new agent in your workspace and join with it (needs agents:create).

idempotency_key.description: Stable caller-chosen key (e.g. a random UUID); a retry with the same key is free.
